name: realmock-web
//bundler: next 16 defaults to Turbopack, which rejects the computed dynamic import inside @met4citizen/talkinghead (modules/talkinghead.mjs builds 'lipsync-<lang>.mjs' at runtime, so the specifier cannot be resolved statically). We pass lipsyncModules: [] and never load them, but the bundler analyses the whole vendor module regardless. dev and build therefore both pass --webpack; they must stay in sync or local dev would run a different bundler than CI ships. Remove both flags once the vendor ships a statically analysable entry or the build moves off this module.
//venv-python: The openapi scripts must run under the project venv interpreter (not the PATH python): the backend package is only installed there once the system editable install is removed, keeping the contract export on the same dependency versions pytest and CI verify.
